summary: No article was written. Repository-held evidence for the life line's curvature is exactly the already-published 'wide arc / narrow arc' reading in life-line.md and 04-life-line.mdx (Benham 1900, West 1998), and that reading is definitionally tied to the Mount of Venus territory the arc encloses -- there is no independent, mount-free curved/straight life-line interpretation anywhere in repository evidence. The task packet's evidence boundary explicitly forbids inferring a curved-vs-straight interpretation from Mount of Venus material, so building the article on that arc reading would be exactly the prohibited inference under new search-query vocabulary, not a genuinely separate claim. A precedent exists on the site for curvature as a standalone, non-mount interpretive axis (the heart line's path in 02-heart-line.mdx and heart-line-ending-meaning.md), but it does not transfer: the heart line's curve is independent of any mount, while the life line's arc is definitionally the Mount of Venus boundary. External verification of the named primary sources (Cheiro 1916, Benham 1900, Gettings 1965, West 1998, Fincham 2005) for an independent treatment was attempted and blocked by this environment's network egress proxy (confirmed live via a blocked WebFetch to Project Gutenberg's Cheiro text). Full disposition recorded in docs/source-verification-log.md Pass 14.
